entries.round: task:Implement Task 3.2: Pre-Write Artifact Gate in orchestrator.py. 1. In _call_agent, after a response is validated by validator.py, check if it contains <write_file> tags. 2. If it does, invoke the 'code_reviewer' agent to review the artifact. 3. Feed the review result back to the original agent if it fails (FAIL status). 4. Log the review status. 5. Add a --skip-review flag to bypass this. IMPORTANT: Wrap the entire modified orchestrator.py in <write_file path="orchestrator.py"> tags.
